source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
**[[PSYCHIC]](vsdata:weapon-ability/psychic)** attacks made by friendly ORKS PSYKER models get +1 S, plus another +1 S per 5 models in the model's unit (or embarked within that model). Such models also have two psychic abilities, each of psychic level 1.
Roar of Mork: in your Movement phase, provided this unit isn't battle-shocked, you may roll one D6 as a psychic roll for it. If you do, it becomes battle-shocked on a 1, and whatever the result you pick one enemy unit within 12" of it that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE; that unit takes a battle-shock roll at −1 per 10 models this unit contains.
Visions of Violence: as any Fight phase begins, provided this unit isn't battle-shocked, you may roll one D6 as a psychic roll for it. If you do, it becomes battle-shocked on a 1, and whatever the result it has **[Fights First](vsdata:core-ability/fights-first)** for the rest of that phase.

extraStrengthPer.counted: in this unit or embarked within this model

detail.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: the text gives no duration, so the effect lasts only for the phase in which it was applied.
